Parsing, signatures, reference values and root dependencies are unchanged. Notebook SQL executes only the published v0.4.0 runtime; current interface coverage is a compatibility review, not execution of current-main source. A supplementary existing-binary catalog probe agrees, but its build provenance is not asserted.

review.purpose: Distinguish a parseable public file from malformed bytes, absent paths and missing input before summarizing event evidence.
review.finding: The public fixture constructs a parser; malformed bytes return false. Absent paths and SQL NULL both yield NULL. Header validity does not establish authenticity, intact records or complete collection.

review.purpose: Cross-check the scalar parsed-record total against the materialized event rows while separating zero from missing evidence.
review.finding: The scalar reports seven records and agrees with the table count. Deliberate malformed bytes yield zero while absent and missing inputs yield NULL; agreement is internal consistency, not acquisition completeness.

review.purpose: Build a UTC event timeline once and test whether changing display bins changes underlying evidence.
review.finding: Seven records span roughly 34 seconds. Four 10-second bins retain all seven and have a largest count of four; changing width to 30 gives two bins with a largest count of five. Per-event evidence remains fixed; counts are not production event rates.

review.purpose: Label events without dropping records missing from a deliberately limited provider/channel reference.
review.finding: A checked left join labels only one of seven events (Security event 4625, Failed logon), preserving six unlabeled records. Unique reference keys and matching provider/channel prevent unintended multiplication or cross-provider interpretation; a label alone is not an attack determination.
